title: Classic Jamaican Yam Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting Jamaican-inspired casserole featuring yams, perfect for a warm and satisfying meal. This recipe is a twist on a traditional casserole, with a boost of Caribbean flavor.
instructions: Peel and dice the yams into 1-inch cubes.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in flour; cook for 1 minute.
Slowly add milk, whisking continuously; bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and add cheddar cheese; stir until melted and smooth.
Add cumin, nutmeg, and salt to taste. Stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, combine the cooked yams and cheese sauce. Mix well.
Transfer the yam mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the casserole is golden brown and the yams are tender.
